items.t: The Nuclear Stock AI Investors Loved Is Down 33% This Year. Is Constellation Energy a Buy Now?

items.t: Constellation Completes $5B Sale of 4.4GW PJM Assets to LS Power
items.sum: Part of Constellation's regulatory commitments related to its acquisition of Calpine, the sale to LS Power consisted of the Bethlehem, York 1 and York 2 facilities in Pennsylvania and Hay Road and Edge Moor in Delaware.

items.t: NEE or CEG: Which Clean Energy Stock Is Better Positioned for Growth?
